verdict.rationale: Capacities documents templates that prefill both the properties and the content blocks of an object, which covers defining reusable templates for recurring kinds of notes. The evidence never mentions dynamic variables such as date or title. It also gives no detail on how templates are applied when an object is created, such as defaults per object type or applying them to daily notes. Missing for 10: template variables (date/title substitution), documented apply-on-create or default-per-type behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
